data.body_html:
Andalusia Day 2038 – 28 February – is the perfect excuse to trade the crowded plazas for the open sea. With a yacht charter in Marbella, you can celebrate the region's autonomy in style: sipping cava off the Golden Mile, dropping anchor near Cala Cortés, and enjoying free-flowing drinks and snacks without a single queue. Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, and prices start at €749 for 2 hours – including skipper, fuel, and VAT. Here's everything you need to plan your Andalusia Day celebration on the water.

Why Celebrate Andalusia Day on a Yacht?

Andalusia Day (Día de Andalucía) commemorates the 1980 referendum that granted the region self-government. Every 28 February, towns across Andalusia fly the green-and-white flag, hold street parties, and serve free bread with olive oil. In Marbella, the atmosphere is electric – but the beaches and restaurants get packed. A private yacht charter lets you enjoy the holiday without the crowds. Cruise from Puerto Banús to Cabopino, anchor in a quiet cove, and toast the region with a glass of cava – all while your skipper handles the navigation.

Our Fleet for Andalusia Day 2038

We operate a range of motor yachts, catamarans, and speedboats from Puerto Banús. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. Below are the most popular choices for groups celebrating the holiday.

What to Expect on Andalusia Day Weather-Wise

February in Marbella brings mild, often sunny days. Average highs reach 17°C, lows around 9°C, and sea temperatures hover at 15°C. Rain is possible – about 6 days in the month – but the sun usually wins. We recommend bringing a light jacket or jumper for the breeze, especially if you're on a flybridge or open speedboat. If the forecast turns bad, we can reschedule or refund your booking.

Best Itineraries for a 2-Hour or 4-Hour Charter

From Puerto Banús, you have several scenic routes. For a 2-hour charter (€749), head west past the Golden Mile and Marbella Marina, then loop back. For 4 hours or more, you can reach Cala del Faro, a rocky cove with crystal water, or go east to Cabopino and its dune-backed beach. The Mangusta 80's free jet ski adds a fun element – tow a friend or explore the shoreline up close.

How to Book Your Andalusia Day Yacht Charter

Reservations are open now for 2038. Because Andalusia Day is a public holiday, availability is limited – especially for the popular Tier A boats and the Mangusta 80. To secure your slot, visit our homepage and click the WhatsApp button, or email us directly. We'll confirm the boat, time, and any extras (catering, decorations) within hours. Payment is secure via bank transfer or card.

Celebrate Andalusia Day in Style – On the Water

Skip the crowded tapas bars and celebrate Andalusia Day 2038 on a private yacht. Whether you choose the budget-friendly Astondoa 40 or the show-stopping Ferretti 94, you'll enjoy the coast with your own skipper, free drinks, and zero stress. Book your Marbella yacht charter today and make this 28 February one to remember.
